title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Blueberry Raspberry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: The Hayati Pro Max Plus 6000 Blueberry Raspberry Prefilled Pod combines two classic berries in one bright fruit blend. Sweet, juicy Blueberry lays down a smooth base, while Raspberry adds a tangy edge that lifts the flavour with a sharper berry note. Together, they create a well-rounded vape that balances sweetness and tartness with ease. Each pod is designed for the Hayati Pro Max Pod Kit and includes a 2ml pod automatically replenished by the built-in 10ml refill pod. With a total of 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid, you can swap flavours without handling messy refills or coil changes. Capable of delivering up to 6000 puffs (approx.), these pods are powered by dual mesh coil technology to maintain flavour consistency throughout. Insert into your Hayati Pro Max device for long-lasting performance. Check out our full range of Hayati Pro Max Plus Refill Pods to explore more flavours.
